class.name: GDK
class.brief_description: Native Xbox GDK runtime singleton for Xbox on PC.
class.description: Access via [code]Engine.get_singleton("GDK")[/code]. Provides Xbox Game Runtime initialization, task-queue dispatch, and Xbox Live service namespaces.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the GDK runtime and shared task queue.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the active GDK session (process-lifetime runtime remains until exit).

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this build was compiled with GDK support.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after a successful [method initialize] call.

method.name: dispatch
method.description: Pumps the GDK completion port; call each frame or enable [code]gdk/runtime/embed_dispatch[/code].
